tips.text:
Yuriko the Tiger's Shadow
Assassine (Sin) - Global - Season 1

Last Update (06.11): Updated Arcana levels for Endgame and Ultimate builds to more reasonable ones to reach targets, active skills are changed only on one ring. Also Ariel Daevanion boards from Fire Temple and Ferocious Horn Den Hard Mode extended pre-release on 11.11. you need 2800 GS to enter. Renamed Endgame skillset to Farming, created Bossing setup as this was confusing for most and updated PvP setup.

P.S.: Insignia can be well played with -3 CDR and Multi-Hit as stacks are build up fast via HG and SR but still you can try to push to 20 for more DPS but imho not necessary target breakpoint but still can be pushed 6 more levels if you min-max.

Item Upgrades through Campaign Acts 1 to 6 without running Expedition Chests and spending any Odyle Energy
Noble Belt and Revelation Amulet Upgrades through 100% Silent Dungeons plus Strongholds and Substance Morph get Enhancement Materials fast through Daily Dungeon with Instant Tickets

Non-Crafted and Crafted Versions:
Early Endgame 1000-1800 Use Berk Accessories and Bakarma Defensive Equipment or first crafted Star Dragon Lord Items
Mid Endgame 1800-2500+ bolster up with higher Item Levels from Vakron and Uruguru Expedition Bosses or more crafted Defensive Equipment from Star Dragon Lord or on plus Upgrade our existing via Transfer Crafting to Dark Dragon Lord
Late Endgame 2800+ (Ludra Ready) for Kromede and Nuakum Items from Fire Temple and Ferocious Horn Den or Crafted Equipment via Transfer Crafting to Ebony Dragon Lord with priority on Weapon, Guard and Jewelry
Ultimate 2800-3600+ all crafted defensive items to Ebony Dragon Lord with Ludra Gear bracelet until Mythics come out

Genus System Pets Upgrade Order Lines for each Board: Line 4 > Line 1, 5 > Line 6, 9, Line 7, Line 2, 8
Recommended to start with Special Board for Double Chance but all to Level 10 is necessary for title Unbound by Genus so farm Hidden Cubes for Rainbow Crystals and level your pets to maximum to receive crystals at your farming spot for each category

Transcendent Bakarma do your 10x Draupnir runs to receive statue for Pantheon (not necessary to spend any Odyle on it but will be blocked)

Golden Chalice of Vigor collect 5x Mysterious Crystals as fast as you can to craft Arcana card with Heart Gore on it for Level 16 or what you prefer: Receive it via season rewards for running Ascension Trial (Score higher than 4000+ for 3), use season shop (better to save for wings) or run Transcendence and scrap lower cards for Crystals.

Other Arcanas like Mirror, Bell, Compass and Parchment on Mid and Late Endgame have skills with levels added to reach active ones to Level 20 including Heart Gore, Quick Slice, Insignia Explosion, Savage Roar and Storm Rampage. Priority passive ones are added as Rear Smite, Assault Stance, Impact Hit and Exploit Weakness. If you're above Level 20 with one skill that frees up slot on ring for example for others passives so mix-and-mash so you reach the targets.

Macros we using simple right-click configuration for it on Shadowblade Priority 0 (higher mobility on mobs) with left-click for Quick Slice for weaving and animation cancelling on holding both. Insignia Explosion needs to trigger continuously and can be built in additionally as skill slot but using currently external mouse button macro for faster activation everything else is burst buff on stagger phases like Illusive Clone, Swift Contract and using Shadow Strike with Triniel's Dagger in back or movement positioning like Flash Slice, Infiltrate and Shadowstrike

Updated configuration maybe it helps someone for mouse triggering Insignia Explosion, burst to trigger all buffs, Flashslice for repositioning from front to back and using Shadowstrike to zap into back and pull Triniel's debuff also updated macro for using Storm Rampage, Infiltrate and Ambush:

Bossing setup in slot 2 for example just swap Shadowblade Stigma out for Savage Fang as add-on to buff skill sl

tips.title: Yuriko the Tiger's Shadow (Farming)
tips.text:
Update (30.10): Changed Macro Chain for more DPS: Insignia Explosion to skill slot with Storm Rampage and Ambush into the first macro rotation
Update (26.10): Changed Macro Chain as I got nudged from another sin why HG on Level 16 is not triggering as often as it could even on CDR reset: Put Insignia back into internal chain from external, moved Storm Rampage out and and stacked Whirlwind Slice into another skill stack.
Update (23.10): Moved Triniel's Dagger to Shadowstrike skill slot so it's used behind switched a bit of priorities and levels. Increased Quick Slice to 20 for additional ignoring Block and Evasion and Savage Roar for more damage on less targets. Couldn't remove Stigmas levels so put unused ones back to 1. Feel free to swap around Shadowblade with Savage Fang for bossing instead of farming.

• In PvE we can take off Quick Slice out of Macro and use Macro button + Hold down Quick Slice at the same time for Animation cancel and deal more dps that way. And always capped MP.

• For PvE Farming in Abyss, take Shadow Walk instead of Savage Fang to disengage when someone attacked us

• Combat power improve (Gearscore doesn't related to CP):
- Genus Insight (everything level 10 first, Cubes, Spam for orange+gold)
- Stigma Shard (Shugo, Abyss, Nightmare, PvP, Supply Request)
- Statue (Draupnir guarantee)
- Artwork (Crafting level, World boss Scraps, Expe Bosses, Market Purchase)
- Collossus (Zikel Nightmare final boss)
- Title (Achievements, World Bosses Secured, Unbound by Genus with lvl 10 all Genus, Defense one from campaign, Utility from all Seal or Lagta boss)
- Wings (Collect Own effects check Sources, Best wings from season shop,2nd best is Dark Veiled, Forest give most boss dps)
- Manastone (higher tier = more GS and CP)
- Theostone (give GS but not CP)
- Daevanion (buy all 416)
- Items (Enhance, Amplify, Soulbind good stats)
- Arcana (Skill level for milestones, higher level gives more stats, Mana set for Bell or Compass gives better stats than Vigor set)

- Closet (On Main and Alt Buy all non-main char's weapon from Black Cloud Merchant Reset, Savage drops from main+alt, Combine, buy all weapons if have kina to reach 700 skins title, Trade Shop with Alt)
- Pets (Get all Might/Cogni, buy unfarmable in Merchant, farm others later)
- Buy All Daevanion Points (Prio Atk,Crit over useless skills, new Ariel Board in new patch)

• MOST IMPORTANT:
Genus Insight, Pets, Pantheon, Wings, Title, Gears, Skills level.
Best Stats on Gears (Don't Have to be perfect, 1 or 2 is good):
- Weapon: Weapon Dmg Boost > Damage Boost > Combat Speed > Might > Multi-Hit (if not Assa) > Attack > Precision > Crit Atk > Skill
- Guard: Weapon Dmg Boost > Damage Boost > Combat Speed > Might > Multi-Hit (if not Assa) > Attack > Precision > Skill
- Helm: Double Chance > Attack Increase > Attack > Skill
- Pauldrons: Double Chance > Crit Dmg Boost > Attack > Skill
- Breastplate: Perfect Chance > Damage Boost > Attack > Skill
- Pants: Damage Tolerance > Perfect Chance > Attack Increase > Attack > Skill
- Gloves: Combat Speed > Perfect Chance > Attack > Skill
- Boots: Movement Speed > Perfect Chance > Attack > Skill
- Cloak: Double Chance > Attack Increase > Attack > Skill
- Earrings: Movement Speed > Might > Attack > Precision > Skill
- Necklace: Combat Speed > Might > Attack > Skill
- Rings: Skill > Might > Attack

• Best Genus Insight: Double Chance (Special) > Damage Boost > Damage Tolerance > Max Attack > Attack Bonus > Power Shard > Accuracy > %HP . PvE > Normal > Crit > Boss > Back/Front

• Best Manastone: Attack Gold > Crit Gold > Attack > Crit

• Trick Soul Bind: Transfer from random low level items is cheaper than Sync, even level 10-15 first before transfer, less Kina cost, whale even level to 15 to transfer. Use Soul Bind Codex on higher level pieces.

• Gold Items Farm: Shugo, World Bosses, Space Time Rift World Bosses, Invasion, Alt Expedition Spam, Abyss Mods (buffed rate).

• Weapon Best Theostone: Earth > Fire > Water (single target) Paralyze for PvP

Assassin Build – Teivor | Lumiel | Zenas
Hey hey!
My in-game name is Teivor. I play on Lumiel and lead the german guild Zenas.
I'm constantly testing and tweaking my build, so keep in mind that things may change over time if you decide to use it.

Skill Priorities
Active Skills
Quick Slice (20) > Heart Gore (20) > Insignia Explosion (20) >> Storm Rampage (16)
These are the three most important active skills to prioritize. They will be your main sources of damage, while Storm Rampage comes next.
Everything else is significantly less important in terms of damage or is mainly used for mobility.
Passive Skills
Rear Smite > Assault Stance > Impact Hit > Exploit Weakness
Prioritize the first three passives and level them up as much as possible. Some Korean players aim for level 35 on these skills.
Stigmas
Evasion Stance (5) (optional)
Illusive Clone (20) > Swift Contract (20) > Savage Fang (15) > Triniel's Dagger (10)
Staying alive is your highest DPS increase.
If you can't execute the boss perfectly yet, I'd recommend using Evasion Stance for extra survivability.
Since the recent buffs, Illusive Clone and Swift Contract share a cooldown. Even so, I want to emphasize that you should always use these two skills together to get the most out of them.

If you have any feedback, suggestions, or recommendations, feel free to let me know!
I'm always looking for ways to improve the build.

01 mínima e 01+
Equipamento das duas: Aulamus Dagger +10 (SUGESTÃO pra 'dagger de dungeon'; drop IL70, confirme a origem). Guard Vakron +10. Armadura Vakron +10 (SUGESTÃO, o conjunto da referência j0ei). Acessórios (SUGESTÃO): Aulamus +10, Ascension e Liberator Bracelet +10, Noble Belt +5, Fierce Battle Amulet +5, Clash Rune x2 +2.
O que muda entre elas: na mínima, as cartas não contam com nenhuma linha de skill, e a arma e o guard têm uma linha de Heart Gore cada no lugar do Damage Boost. Com isso Heart Gore chega a 16 sem Arcana e mantém o reset da recarga ao acertar crítico. Na 01+, cada carta tem 3 linhas em Lv 3 escolhidas pra fechar as metas, e a arma e o guard voltam pro Damage Boost.
Painel da 01 mínima: Accuracy 235; PvP Accuracy 108; Critical Hit 617; Combat Speed 33,2%; Damage Boost 4,89%; PvP Damage Boost 26%; PvP Damage Tolerance 4%; Status Effect Resist 44,5%; HP 10.924. A 01+ é igual, só que com Damage Boost 14,7%.
Theostone fica vazia na 01: origem e custo não aparecem no Questlog, e a etapa econômica não deve depender disso.
02A e 02B - Objetivo de progressão PvP
Etapa planejada: arma +15 (Potential 2), armadura +12, atributos no meio da faixa. Arma Enraged Kromede Silver Dagger (guia). Guard Nuakum (SUGESTÃO); o guia manda comparar com Wise Dragon Lord Guard, que é Elyos, e o equivalente Asmodian é Ebony Dragon Lord Guard. Armadura Nuakum +12. Acessórios: Enraged Kromede +10, Abyssal Bracelet x2, Noble Belt +10, Fierce Battle Amulet +10, Clash Rune x2 +5.
Painel da 02B: Accuracy 272; PvP Accuracy 148; Critical Hit 773; Combat Speed 42%; Damage Boost 10,9%; PvP Damage Boost 33%; PvP Damage Tolerance 10%; Status Effect Resist 56,5%; HP 14.659.
SUGESTÃO, igual nas duas: Abyssal Bracelet x2 com time, death, illusion e life em 13 (meio da faixa 9-17). Philosopher's Stone da arma: mantido (Critical Hit).
Theostones (SUGESTÃO, iguais em 02A e 02B): arma com Meslamtaeda's Greed, 3% de chance de Stun por 3s ao atacar; guard com Kaisinel's Reverie, 3% de chance de -50% Move Speed por 7s. O que a DB do Questlog confirma: as duas ativam ao atacar, têm recarga de efeito de 5s, não podem ser negociadas e, se forem iguais, só uma vale. O que ela não confirma: se a do guard ativa como a da arma, se duas pedras diferentes somam ou se atrapalham, e o efeito real contra jogadores. O guia não indica Theostone.
Acerto (02A) x Dano/defesa (02B)
As duas diferem só em:
• Substats: 10 linhas de Accuracy na 02A (Helm, Shoulders, Pants, Gloves, Boots, Cape, Earrings x2, Necklace e anel esquerdo). Na 02B, essas linhas viram Attack increase (Helm, Pants, Cape), Double Chance (Shoulders), Endurance Penetration (Gloves, Boots) e Attack (Earrings, Necklace, anel).

• Pedras: a 1ª Manastone das 12 peças de armadura e acessórios é PvP Accuracy +18 na 02A e PvP Critical Hit +18 na 02B. Arma, guard e braceletes têm PvP Accuracy nas duas.

O que a 02A ganha: Accuracy 750 contra 272 e PvP Accuracy 364 contra 148.
O que a 02A paga: Attack 1.375 contra 1.483 (-108); Attack increase 0% contra 5,56%; PvP Critical Hit 151 contra 367 (-216); Double Chance 6,34% contra 7,88%; Endurance Penetration 9,7% contra 13,2%. Critical Hit (773), Damage Boost e HP ficam iguais.
A 02A não é restauração: o Accuracy de antes da troca não ficou registrado. As linhas voltaram às posições registradas, com valores pela regra atual. Trate a 02A como proposta nova.
Como decidir:

tips.title: Paulo - Assassin PvP | 01 mínima (sem cartas)
tips.text:
Etapa 01 mínima: não depende de nenhuma linha de Arcana. Asmodian, Global, sem cash. Sem teste prático.
Níveis (total = bônus sem Arcana + direto): Quick Slice 13 (3 + 10), Heart Gore 16 (6 + 10), Insignia Explosion 14 (4 + 10), Defiance 12 (3 + 9), Shadowstrike, Flash Slice e Shadow Fall 12 (2 + 10).
Por que Heart Gore chega a 16: a arma e o guard da 01 mínima têm uma linha de Heart Gore cada, no lugar do Damage Boost. Assim ela mantém a especialização de nível 16 (reset da recarga ao acertar crítico). O preço: Damage Boost cai de 14,7% para 4,89% no painel.
Custo: 143 SP. Insignia Explosion no nível direto 10 pede personagem nível 38. Os estigmas usam outro recurso: 70 pontos de estigma neste preset.
O que fica de fora: Quick Slice sem ignorar Block/Evasion e Insignia Explosion sem os -3s de recarga (as duas pedem 16).
Se faltar SP, os níveis diretos 8 a 10 são os mais caros (4 SP cada). Quando as cartas vierem com as linhas certas, use o preset 'Inicial', vinculado à 01+.

tips.title: Paulo - Assassin PvP | Daevanion Inicial
tips.text:
Daevanion INICIAL para a proposta PvP Assassin (Asmodian, Global). Rota calculada pelo caminho mais barato até os nós de skill, sem teste prático.
Escopo: só Nezekan e Zikel (primeiros tabuleiros), apenas nós das skills centrais. Custo: 91 pontos de Daevanion.
Níveis de skill entregues: Quick Slice +2; Shadowstrike +2; Shadow Fall +2; Flash Slice +2; Heart Gore +2; Insignia Explosion +2; Defiance +2; Rear Smite +1; Determination +1; Impact Hit +1; Revitalization Contract +1.
Limite: não sei quantos pontos você terá em cada etapa. Se faltar ponto, corte primeiro os nós de passiva e mantenha os caminhos das skills centrais. Os nós de atributo no caminho entram só porque são passagem obrigatória.

tips.title: Paulo - Assassin PvP | Objetivo
tips.text:
Proposta Assassin PvP com burst e defesa ativa (Asmodian, Global). Etapa: OBJETIVO (marcos posteriores do guia). Sem teste prático.
NÍVEIS: metas TOTAIS (pontos diretos + equipamento + Daevanion + Arcana).
NÚCLEO (guia): Quick Slice 16 (ignora Block/Evasion + -1s cooldown da Explosion); Heart Gore 20 (reset por crítico); Insignia Explosion 20 (preserva Insignias + -3s cooldown); Defiance 16 (proteção após controle); Shadowstrike 12; Flash Slice 12 (alcance + uso adicional); Shadow Fall 12 (sequência de controle).
ESTIGMAS (guia): Illusive Clone 20; Swift Contract 15; Savage Fang 15; Evasion Stance 10. Evasion Stance substitui Triniel's Dagger do núcleo publicado: troca defensiva NÃO testada.
PASSIVAS (guia, via equipamento): Rear Smite, Exploit Weakness, Assault Stance, Impact Hit.
SUGESTÃO: 3ª especialização só nas skills de nível 20 (abaixo disso o jogo libera 2 espaços); demais ativas em Lv 1 só para completar a barra.
USO (guia): escolha alvo e janela antes de gastar o Clone; entre, controle e cause dano; quando a janela fechar, preserve recursos para reposicionar. Não gaste todos os deslocamentos só para alcançar o inimigo.
